title: ModalFidelity: Routing Modalities for Deepfake Detection on a Budget
abstract: arXiv:2609.38246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deepfakes no longer need to fake a whole video. Generators that read the transcript now alter only the few seconds in which a video's meaning turns, so a forgery hides in a small, unknown fraction of the video. Yet detectors still read every one-second window of both the audio and image streams, spending nearly all of their compute where nothing was altered. We observe that deciding where to look is far cheaper than looking. We present ModalFidelity, a lightweight router that previews each window and decides, before any forensic detector runs, which stream is worth reading, under a hard compute budget it can never exceed. On AV-Deepfake1M, reading at most a fifth of the windows, it is more accurate than gating after the detectors at 15.9x less compute, and retains over 96% of the accuracy of an oracle that knows where every forgery lies.

translated_title: ModalFidelity：预算受限下的深度伪造检测模态路由
translated_abstract: 深度伪造不再需要伪造整个视频。能够读取文本转录的生成器现在只需篡改视频含义发生转折的少数几秒钟，因此伪造内容隐藏在视频中一小段未知的位置。然而，现有检测器仍然会读取音频流和图像流的每一个一秒窗口，把几乎全部计算资源浪费在没有被篡改的地方。我们观察到，决定往哪里看远比看本身便宜得多。我们提出了ModalFidelity，一个轻量级路由器，它在任何取证检测器运行之前预览每个窗口，并决定哪个流值得读取，同时严格遵守一个绝不超出的硬性计算预算。在AV-Deepfake1M数据集上，它最多只读取五分之一的窗口，却比在检测器之后进行门控的方法更准确，计算量减少15.9倍，并保留了一个知晓每处伪造位置的神谕模型96%以上的准确率。
tldr: ModalFidelity提出一种轻量级路由器，在运行昂贵的取证检测器之前预先判断每个时间窗口的音视频流是否值得分析，在硬性计算预算下将深度伪造检测的计算量降低15.9倍，同时达到比检测器后门控更高的准确率。
en_tdlr: ModalFidelity is a lightweight router that previews each window and decides which audio-visual stream is worth reading before any forensic detector runs, cutting compute by 15.9x while achieving higher accuracy than post-detector gating on AV-Deepfake1M.
